content: Yakub Labonor górot fõisse
Bade Yakube zat roiye edde fuk mullukka okkolor dešot aišše.
Heṛe hibaye maṛot maze uggwa kuwa deikke, ar so, hibar ḍake tinnuwa berasoolor zãk luṛiroiye, kiyollahoile he kuwattu hinore fani fiyaito. Ar kuwawar mukot ekkan beši ḍõr fattor.
Ar heṛe zãk okkol beggun zẽtte dola oito, hitara kuwar mukor fattorguware algaiyore zãkore fani fiyaito. Tarfore hitara fattorguware abar uwafes loi kuwar mukot buwai dito.
Yakube soolsoroya okkolore fusar goredde, "Ãr báiyain okkol, tũwara hoṛiyar?" "Ãra Harranottu" hoi hitara zuwab diye.
Yakube hitarare hodde, "Tũwara Nahuror nati, Labonore sino ne?" "Oi, ãra sini," hoi zuwab diye.
Tarfore Yakube hitarare hodde, "Hiba bala asede no ne?" Toi hitara hodde, "Oi, bala ase, ar so, hibar zi Rahela berasoolor zãk loi aiyerwa."
Yakube hodde, "So, beil foitte ar bout deri ase, zanuwaror zãk okkolore ekottro goribar ṭaim aizo no o. Tũwara bolke tũwarar soolgunore fani fiyaiyore hinore abar soraito loizo."
Hitara zuwabe hodde, "Ãra hen gori no faijjum, zãk beggun ekottro no o foijjonto, toi kuwar mukottu fattorgan algaiyore ãra zãkore fani fiyai faijjumde."
Yakube ehono hitara loi hota hor, hen šomot Rahela hibar bafor berasoolor zãk loi heṛe aišše, kiyollahoile hiba aššilde soolsoroni.
Toi Yakube zehon hibar mamu Labonor zi Rahelare edde Labonor soolor zãkore deikke, hibaye ḍake zai kuwar mukottu fattorgan algaiye edde hibar mamu Labonor zãkore fani fiyaiye.
Bade Rahelare suma diye edde õraguzori handa šuru goijje.
Toi Yakube Rahelare hoil ze hiba hibar bafor egena edde Rebekar fut. Toi hibaye dũri giye edde hiyan bafore hoiye.

Ar Labone hitar boinor fut Yakubor babute funiyore, dũri hibar loi deha goitto giye, edde hibar loi ãzaãzi goijje, edde hibare suma diye, edde hibare hitar górot loi ainne, ar heṛe Yakube hitare in okkol beggun hoiye.
Bade Labone hibare hodde, "Soiyi tui ãr nizor ãḍḍi edde gusto." Yakube Leah edde Rahelare biya goijje Toi Yakub hitar górot ek maš taikke,
bade Labone Yakubore hodde, "Tui ãr egena buli ki bina muzoriye ãr ham goribi ne? Tore beton ki diya foribo ãre ho."
Labonottu duizon zi ase; ḍõrguwar nam Leah, ar šoṛowar nam Rahela.
Leattu aššilde šude duwa šundor suk, kintu Rahelar hara ga edde siyara, hár kissu šundor aššil.
Yakube Rahelare muhabbot goitto. Yakube hodde, "Tũwar šoṛo zi Rahelalla ãi hãt bosor tũwar gulami goijjium."
Labone hodde, "Ãi hibare oinno honokiyore diyattuwaro tor diya iyan ãlla aro bala oibo. Tui ãr hãse tak!"
Toi Yakube Rahelalla hãt bosor gulami goijje, ar hibattu hibar uwore muhabbotor zoriya hinore hibattu šude kissu dinor ḍoil laigge.
Tarfore Yakube Labonore hodde, "Ãr din šeš oiye, ehon ãr bou ãre do, ãi zene hiba loi taki fari."
Toi Labone heṛiyar manuš okkol beggunore ekkui fũwati goijje, edde ek hánar entezam goijje.
Ar hazinna zehon oiye, hite hitar zi Leare loi Yakubor hãse ani diye, toi Yakube hibar loi taikke.
Labone hitar bandi Zilpare hitar zi Lealla daima hisabe hibare diye.
Toi binna zehon oiye dekedde, hiba Leah! Toi Yakube Labonore hodde, "Tũi in ãr loi goijjode in ki? Ãi Rahelalla tũwar gulami goijjide, no ne? Tũi ãre dúha kene dila?"
Labone hodde, "Foila zormor age šoṛoware biya diya iyan ãrar ei zagar niyom no.
Tui ei biyar hãt dinna furon gor; bade aro hãt bosor gulamir bodole ãra tore šoṛoware o diyum."
Henot Yakube hendilla goijje, hãt dinna furon goijje, ar Labone hitar zi Rahelare o Yakubor bou oibolla diye.
Labone hitar bandi Bilhare Rahelalla daima hisabe hibare diye.
Yakube Rahela loi o taikke, ar hibaye Leattuwaro Rahelare beši ador goijje. Ar Yakube Labonor hãse aro hãt bosor gulami goijje.
Yakubor fuwain okkol
Bade Mabude zehon deikke ze Leare ador no gore, hibaye hibare hamil oi farefan gori diye, kintu Rahela baz oi roiye.
Leah hamil oiye edde ek futore biyaiye. Hibaye hitar nam raikke Ruben, kiyollahoile hibaye hodde, "Mabude ãr dukkore deikke; ebar ãr šuwamiye ãre hameka ador goribo."
Hiba abar hamil oiye, edde ek futore biyaiye, toi hibaye hodde, "Ãre ador no gorede hiyan Mabude funniye, hetolla hibaye ãre iba o diyede." Toi hibaye hitar nam raikke Simeon.
Hiba abar hamil oiye edde ek futore biyaiye, toi hibaye hodde, "Ebar ãr šuwami ãlloi bazi takibo, kiyollahoile ãi hiballa tin futore zormo diyi." Toi hibaye hitar nam raikke Levi.
Hiba abar hamil oiye edde ek futore biyaiye, toi hibaye hodde, "Ebar ãi Mabudore tarif goriyum." Toi hibaye hitar nam raikke Ehudah. Tarfore hibar fuwa biya bon oigiyegoi.
